{{Quote|If you fly over the ruins, you can see places where there were old excavations, as if someone was digging to try to find jamming equipment, but the field's still there and no one knows why. It must be nearly impossible to search for whatever it is, since any kind of deep terrain sensors won't work there.|[[Alia Terae]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="RE" />}}
This '''unidentified city''' was located on a [[Unidentified planet (Rethel Point)|planet]]<ref name="RE" /> in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its ruins contained shattered towers and circular streets that were covered by sand drifts and vegetation.<ref name="RE" />

The ruined [[City/Legends|city]] emanated a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field known as [[Rethel Point]]. The field spread across most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], growing slightly weaker the farther it stretched from the ruins of the city, and ended just before reaching the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] paths of the planet's two small [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. It was rumored that a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Rethel]], had built the city at one [[Time/Legends|time]] long before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.<ref name="RE" />
